EC1: - Presence of any abnormalities [NOT] preventing reliable measurements
EC2: - Ocular inflammation [OR] and ocular disease interfering with the study aims
EC3: - Use of photosensitizing medication (phototoxic drugs, [OR] photoallergic drugs) in the 3 months preceding the study
EC4: - Presence of any condition with the possibility of causing photosensitivity, including systemic lupus erythematosus SLE, [OR] Porphyria, [OR] Vitiligo, [OR] Xeroderma Pigmentosum [OR] and Albinism
EC5: - Presence of any form of epilepsy
EC6: - Ocular surgery in the 3 months preceding the study
EC8: - Any medical or surgical history, disorder [OR] or disease such as acute [OR] or chronic severe organic disease
